Survey Overview

About the CanHealth 2024 Fictitious National Health Survey

What is CanHealth 2024?

CanHealth 2024 is a fictitious national health survey created to demonstrate the Quarto + DuckDB + Plotly data portal framework. It simulates the structure of real population health surveys such as the Canadian Community Health Survey (CCHS).

Portal last generated: 2026-06-16
Respondents: 5,000
Aggregated output files: 7

Survey design

Feature Detail
Survey name CanHealth 2024 (Fictitious)
Reference population Canadian residents aged 18 and older
Sample size 5,000 synthetic respondents
Sampling design Simulated stratified by province and age
Survey weight Post-stratification weight (mean ≈ 1.0, log-normal noise)
Data collection mode Simulated — see scripts/generate_data.py
Microdata format Apache Parquet (columnar, compressed)

Sample distribution by province

Variables collected

Variable Description
province Province of residence
age_group Age group (7 bands, 18+)
gender Gender identity
income_bracket Household annual income before tax
education Highest educational attainment
survey_weight Post-stratification survey weight (mean ≈ 1.0)
self_rated_health Self-rated general health (5-point scale)
physical_activity Weekly physical activity level
smoking_status Cigarette smoking status
alcohol_frequency Frequency of alcohol consumption
bmi Body Mass Index (continuous, kg/m²)
mental_health_score PHQ-4 proxy score (0–12, higher = worse)
has_family_doctor Has a regular family doctor (0/1)
unmet_care_need Reported an unmet healthcare need in past 12 months (0/1)
er_visits_12mo Emergency room visits in past 12 months (count)
hypertension Has hypertension diagnosis (0/1)
diabetes Has diabetes diagnosis (0/1)
asthma Has asthma diagnosis (0/1)
depression Has depression diagnosis (0/1)
anxiety Has anxiety diagnosis (0/1)
arthritis Has arthritis diagnosis (0/1)
heart_disease Has heart disease diagnosis (0/1)
cancer_history Has cancer history diagnosis (0/1)
any_chronic Has at least one chronic condition (0/1)
chronic_count Number of chronic conditions (count)

How the portal works

This portal is built on three stages that are completely separated from each other:

┌─────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 1: Generate data │  scripts/generate_data.py
│  (run once locally)     │  → data/raw/microdata.parquet
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 2: Tabulate      │  scripts/tabulate.py
│  (run locally before    │  → data/aggregated/*.json
│   every publish)        │
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 3: Quarto render │  quarto render  OR
│  (pure static HTML;     │  quarto publish gh-pages
│   reads only JSON)      │
└─────────────────────────┘

Key privacy property: Only the aggregated JSON files travel to GitHub. The raw data/raw/ folder is listed in .gitignore and is never committed.

All data in this portal are entirely synthetic. No real Canadians or health records are represented. The survey instrument and findings are illustrative only.

## Sample distribution by province

```{python}
#| echo: false
access = load("healthcare_access")
prov_df = pd.DataFrame(access["by_province"]).sort_values("n", ascending=True)

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=prov_df["n"],
    y=prov_df["province"],
    orientation="h",
    marker_color=COLORS["primary"],
    text=prov_df["n"],
    textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="%{y}: %{x} respondents<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="Number of respondents", yaxis_title="")
fig_defaults(fig, "Sample Size by Province / Territory", height=430).show()
```

## Variables collected

```{python}
#| echo: false
codebook_path = Path("data/raw/codebook.json")
if codebook_path.exists():
    codebook = json.loads(codebook_path.read_text())
    rows = [
        f"| `{var}` | {desc} |"
        for var, desc in codebook["variables"].items()
    ]
    table_md = "| Variable | Description |\n|---|---|\n" + "\n".join(rows)
    from IPython.display import Markdown, display
    display(Markdown(table_md))
else:
    print("Codebook not found — run scripts/generate_data.py first.")
```

